title: The Neighbours We Never Meet

sentences.en: In the apartment blocks where a large share of urban families now live, neighbours are people who share a wall but almost nothing else.
sentences.zh: 在如今大量城市家庭居住的公寓楼里，邻居只是与自己共用一堵墙、除此之外几乎毫无交集的人。

sentences.en: Commentators often describe this as a loss, and they are partly right.
sentences.zh: 评论者常把这种状况说成一种损失，而他们说的有一部分是对的。

sentences.en: Yet the quiet distance between neighbours is less a moral failure than a predictable outcome of how modern housing is built and how often people move.
sentences.zh: 然而，邻里之间那种安静的疏远，与其说是道德上的失败，不如说是现代住宅的建造方式与人们搬迁频率共同造成的可预见结果。

sentences.en: A corridor in a tall building is a passage, not a meeting place; it is designed for movement, and people cross it at speed with their eyes on a phone.
sentences.zh: 高层住宅里的走廊是通道，而不是会面的场所；它专为通行而设计，人们低头看着手机匆匆穿过。

sentences.en: Sociologists have long argued that weak ties, the acquaintances we barely know, matter more than we expect, because they carry information that never travels inside our closest circle.
sentences.zh: 社会学家长期以来一直认为，弱关系——那些我们几乎不了解的熟人——比我们以为的更重要，因为它们承载着在最亲密圈子里永远不会流传的信息。

sentences.en: A neighbour who nods in the lift is a weak tie of exactly this kind: cheap to maintain, occasionally useful, and easily lost when the building gives nobody a reason to stop.
sentences.zh: 在电梯里向你点头的邻居正是这样一种弱关系：维护成本很低，偶尔有用，而当楼里没有任何理由让人停下脚步时，它又极易消失。

sentences.en: At the same time, the number of years a family spends in one flat has fallen, and the kind of trust that survives a borrowed ladder takes a long time to grow.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一个家庭在同一套公寓里居住的年数在减少，而那种经得起“借一把梯子”的信任需要很长时间才能生长。

sentences.en: None of this means that neighbours have stopped mattering.
sentences.zh: 这一切并不意味着邻居已经不再重要。

sentences.en: In a power cut, a flood or a sudden illness, the person two doors away is the only help that can arrive in minutes.
sentences.zh: 在停电、水灾或突发疾病时，隔两户门的那个人是唯一能在几分钟内赶到的帮手。

sentences.en: Where residents share a garden, a stairwell or a corner for sorting rubbish, they tend to learn names, and once a name is known, small obligations follow.
sentences.zh: 当居民共用一处花园、一段楼梯间或一个垃圾分类角时，他们往往会知道彼此的名字；而一旦知道了名字，小小的责任也就随之而来。

sentences.en: The lesson is not that people have grown colder, but that shared space, rather than shared feeling, is what produces contact.
sentences.zh: 这里要说明的并不是人变得更冷漠了，而是产生接触的是共享的空间，而非共享的情感。

sentences.en: Nostalgia for the old courtyard is a poor guide to policy, since the courtyard also carried gossip, surveillance and very little privacy.
sentences.zh: 对旧日大院的怀念并不是好的政策指南，因为大院同时也带来了闲言碎语、彼此监视和极少的隐私。

sentences.en: A better aim is to build the modern equivalent of the well: a bench, a workshop, a laundry room, some ordinary place where the same faces appear at the same hour.
sentences.zh: 更好的目标是建造现代版的“水井”：一条长椅、一间工具房、一个洗衣房，某个普通的地方，让同样的面孔在同样的时间出现。

sentences.en: Neighbourliness, in other words, is less a virtue to be preached than an opportunity to be designed.
sentences.zh: 换言之，邻里之情与其说是一种需要宣扬的美德，不如说是一个需要被设计出来的机会。

keyVocab.note: 常与 for 连用，nostalgia for the old courtyard 表示对旧日大院的怀念
不可数名词，指持续的、带审视意味的观察
比 duty 更强调由关系、承诺带来的约束
the modern equivalent of ... 表示“相当于……的现代版本”
a virtue to be preached 指停留在口头倡导层面的美德

grammar.en: Yet the quiet distance between neighbours is less a moral failure than a predictable outcome of how modern housing is built and how often people move.
grammar.main: the quiet distance is less a moral failure than a predictable outcome
grammar.subject: the quiet distance between neighbours
grammar.object: less a moral failure than a predictable outcome
grammar.modifiers: between neighbours 是介词短语作后置定语修饰 distance；of how modern housing is built and how often people move 是介词 of 引导的两个并列宾语从句，共同修饰 outcome
grammar.logic: less ... than ... 是比较结构，否定前者、肯定后者，把解释从道德层面转到结构与行为层面，Yet 承接上句的让步
grammar.zh: 然而，邻里之间的疏远与其说是道德失败，不如说是住宅建造方式与搬迁频率带来的可预见结果。

grammar.en: Sociologists have long argued that weak ties, the acquaintances we barely know, matter more than we expect, because they carry information that never travels inside our closest circle.
grammar.main: Sociologists have long argued that weak ties matter more than we expect
grammar.subject: Sociologists
grammar.modifiers: the acquaintances we barely know 是 weak ties 的同位语，其中 we barely know 是省略关系词的定语从句；more than we expect 是比较状语；because 引导原因状语从句，其中 that never travels inside our closest circle 修饰 information
grammar.logic: 主句＋同位语定义＋比较＋原因从句四层叠加，先把抽象概念说清，再解释它为何重要
grammar.zh: 社会学家一直认为，弱关系（我们几乎不认识的熟人）比我们以为的更重要，因为它们承载着最亲密圈子里不会流传的信息。

grammar.en: Where residents share a garden, a stairwell or a corner for sorting rubbish, they tend to learn names, and once a name is known, small obligations follow.
grammar.main: they tend to learn names, and small obligations follow
grammar.subject: they / small obligations
grammar.modifiers: Where 引导地点条件状语从句，其中 for sorting rubbish 修饰 corner；once a name is known 是时间状语从句，用被动表示“名字被知晓之后”
grammar.logic: 条件—结果链条：共享空间带来相识，相识带来责任；and 把两步结果并列推进
grammar.zh: 当居民共用花园、楼梯间或垃圾分类角时，他们往往会知道彼此的名字；一旦知道了名字，小小的责任也随之而来。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why contact between neighbours has weakened and how design could restore it
Why old courtyards were better places to raise children
How to complain effectively about noisy neighbours
Why villages are friendlier than large cities
quiz.evidence: Yet the quiet distance between neighbours is less a moral failure than a predictable outcome of how modern housing is built and how often people move.
quiz.explain: 全文先提出邻里疏远源于住宅设计与流动性，再分析弱关系的价值，最后落到“共享空间需要被设计”这一主张，故主旨是疏远的原因与补救方向。
whyWrong: 文中明确说大院也带来闲言碎语和监视，并未主张它更适合养育孩子。
全文没有涉及投诉或噪音处理的具体做法。
文章讨论的是城市公寓楼，没有比较城乡差别。

quiz.question: What does the author mean by 'the modern equivalent of the well'?
options: A shared everyday place that brings the same people together regularly
A water supply system installed in new apartment buildings
An online group where residents exchange information
A traditional custom that young people should learn
quiz.evidence: A better aim is to build the modern equivalent of the well: a bench, a workshop, a laundry room, some ordinary place where the same faces appear at the same hour.
quiz.explain: 冒号后的列举（长椅、工具房、洗衣房）和“同样的面孔在同样时间出现”说明，作者指的是能让人反复相遇的日常共享场所，水井只是比喻。
whyWrong: 冒号后列举的是长椅、工具房、洗衣房，不是供水设施。
作者强调的是物理空间里的重复相遇，不是线上群组。
作者恰恰反对以怀旧和传统作为政策依据。

quiz.question: According to the passage, what often leads neighbours to learn each other's names?
options: Sharing a garden, a stairwell or a rubbish-sorting corner
Living in the same flat for many years
Meeting in the corridor every morning
Attending the same school or workplace
quiz.evidence: Where residents share a garden, a stairwell or a corner for sorting rubbish, they tend to learn names, and once a name is known, small obligations follow.
quiz.explain: 原文直接指出，共用花园、楼梯间或垃圾分类角时，居民往往会知道彼此的名字。
whyWrong: 原文说居住年数在下降，且长住本身不等于互相认识。
走廊被描述为通道，人们匆匆穿过，不会因此认识彼此。
文中未提及学校或工作单位。

quiz.question: What is the author's attitude towards nostalgia for the old courtyard?
options: Sympathetic but doubtful as a basis for policy
Fully supportive, since courtyards created strong trust
Completely dismissive, since courtyards no longer exist
Neutral, since the passage does not judge courtyards
quiz.evidence: Nostalgia for the old courtyard is a poor guide to policy, since the courtyard also carried gossip, surveillance and very little privacy.
quiz.explain: 作者承认怀念可以理解，但用 since 从句指出大院的代价，从而否定它作为政策依据的可靠性，态度是理解而保留。
whyWrong: 作者承认怀念可以理解，但明确指出它不是好的政策指南。
作者没有全盘否定，只是指出大院也有代价。
文中对大院作出了明确评价，并非中立。

quiz.question: Why does the author describe a corridor as a poor place for meeting people?
options: Because it is designed for passing through rather than for staying
Because it is usually too dark and narrow to talk in
Because residents are forbidden to gather there
Because people in tall buildings dislike strangers
quiz.evidence: A corridor in a tall building is a passage, not a meeting place; it is designed for movement, and people cross it at speed with their eyes on a phone.
quiz.explain: 原文用 passage 与 meeting place 的对比、designed for movement 以及人们匆匆穿过来说明：空间的功能决定了它无法成为交往场所。
whyWrong: 文中没有提到光线或宽窄的问题。
文中没有说物业禁止居民在走廊聚集。
作者反对“人变冷漠”的解释，把原因归于空间设计。

title: The Myth of the Efficient Multitasker

sentences.en: Few beliefs about work are as stubborn as the idea that a busy person can do two things at once.
sentences.zh: 关于工作，很少有哪种看法比“忙碌的人能同时做两件事”这个想法更顽固。

sentences.en: The claim sounds modest enough: answer a message during a lecture, follow a recipe while talking on the phone.
sentences.zh: 这个说法听起来并不算大胆：听讲座时回条消息，打电话时照着菜谱做菜。

sentences.en: Research on attention suggests, however, that what we call multitasking is usually rapid switching, and that every switch carries a cost.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于注意力的研究表明，我们所说的多任务通常是快速的切换，而每一次切换都有代价。

sentences.en: When a person moves from one task to another, part of the mind stays behind on the first one, still rehearsing the sentence that was half finished.
sentences.zh: 当一个人从一项任务转向另一项时，一部分心思会留在前一项上，仍在反复琢磨那句没说完的话。

sentences.en: Psychologists call this residue attention residue, and they have measured its effects: a task done in fragments takes longer and is done worse than the same task done in one stretch.
sentences.zh: 心理学家把这种残留称为“注意力残留”，并且测量过它的影响：被切成碎片完成的任务，比一次做完的同样任务耗时更长、质量更差。

sentences.en: The cost is not the few seconds of the switch itself, but the minutes required to rebuild the mental picture that the switch destroyed.
sentences.zh: 代价并不在于切换本身那几秒钟，而在于重建被切换摧毁的那幅心理图景所需的几分钟。

sentences.en: There is an important limit to this argument, and it is worth stating plainly.
sentences.zh: 这个论点有一个重要的限度，值得明说。

sentences.en: Some pairings are genuinely cheap: walking while talking, folding laundry while listening to a podcast, stirring a pot while planning tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 有些搭配确实成本很低：边走边聊、叠衣服时听播客、搅锅时盘算明天的事。

sentences.en: The difference lies in whether the two activities compete for the same mental resource; speech and reading both demand language, while walking and talking do not.
sentences.zh: 差别在于这两件事是否争夺同一种心理资源：说话和阅读都需要语言能力，而走路和说话并不冲突。

sentences.en: So the enemy is not doing two things at once, but doing two things that use the same part of the brain at once.
sentences.zh: 所以真正的敌人不是同时做两件事，而是同时做两件占用大脑同一部位的事。

sentences.en: The practical lesson is therefore narrower than the slogan suggests.
sentences.zh: 因此，实际的启示比那句口号要窄。

sentences.en: It is not that we should abandon all simultaneity, but that we should stop treating attention as a resource with no price.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们要放弃所有同时进行的活动，而是说我们不该再把注意力当成一种没有价格的资源。

sentences.en: The next time a task feels slow, the honest question may be not how to work faster but what else is quietly running in the background.
sentences.zh: 下次当一项任务显得进展缓慢时，该问的也许不是怎样做得更快，而是后台还有什么在悄悄运行。

keyVocab.note: 本指物质残留，此处引申为心思仍停留在前一任务上的状态
still rehearsing the sentence 指脑子里反复过那句话
抽象名词，来自 simultaneous，指多件事同时进行
in fragments 表示“被切成碎片地”，与 in one stretch 对照
in one stretch 意为“一口气、不间断地”

grammar.en: Research on attention suggests, however, that what we call multitasking is usually rapid switching, and that every switch carries a cost.
grammar.main: Research suggests that ... and that ...
grammar.subject: Research on attention
grammar.object: 两个 that 引导的并列宾语从句
grammar.modifiers: however 是插入语，插在主谓之间；第一个宾语从句的主语本身又是一个主语从句 what we call multitasking
grammar.logic: 两个并列宾语从句分别给出“是什么”和“有何代价”，插入语 however 标示与前文流行看法相反
grammar.zh: 然而，关于注意力的研究表明，我们所说的多任务通常是快速切换，而每次切换都有代价。

grammar.en: Psychologists call this residue attention residue, and they have measured its effects: a task done in fragments takes longer and is done worse than the same task done in one stretch.
grammar.main: Psychologists call this residue attention residue, and they have measured its effects
grammar.subject: Psychologists / they
grammar.object: this residue attention residue / its effects
grammar.modifiers: 冒号后是解释 effects 的分句；done in fragments 与 done in one stretch 都是过去分词短语作后置定语，分别修饰两个 task
grammar.logic: 先下定义，再用冒号引出实测结果，构成“术语—证据”结构；than 引出对照项
grammar.zh: 心理学家把这种残留称为注意力残留，并测量了它的影响：碎片化完成的任务比一次做完的同一任务更慢、更差。

grammar.en: The difference lies in whether the two activities compete for the same mental resource; speech and reading both demand language, while walking and talking do not.
grammar.main: The difference lies in ...; speech and reading demand language
grammar.subject: The difference / speech and reading
grammar.object: whether 引导的宾语从句 / language
grammar.modifiers: whether 从句作介词 in 的宾语；while 引导对比状语从句，do not 后省略了 demand language
grammar.logic: 分号连接“判断”与“例证”，while 把两类活动并置对照，省略结构使对比更紧凑
grammar.zh: 差别在于这两项活动是否争夺同一种心理资源；说话和阅读都需要语言，而走路和说话则不然。

title: Who Chooses What You See?
titleZh: 是谁决定了你看到什么

sentences.en: When you open a short-video app, the first clip has already been chosen for you, by a system that has watched your behaviour more closely than any friend has.
sentences.zh: 当你打开一个短视频应用，第一个视频已经替你选好了——选它的是一个比任何朋友都更仔细地观察过你行为的系统。

sentences.en: Critics call this manipulation, and argue that the algorithm narrows what we meet and quietly shapes what we want.
sentences.zh: 批评者称之为操纵，认为算法缩小了我们能接触到的东西，并在悄悄塑造我们的欲望。

sentences.en: The charge is serious, but it is also incomplete, because it treats the viewer as a purely passive object.
sentences.zh: 这个指控很严肃，但也不完整，因为它把观看者当成了完全被动的对象。

sentences.en: There is real evidence behind the worry.
sentences.zh: 这种担忧背后确有真实的证据。

sentences.en: A system trained to maximise watch time learns that familiar and emotionally charged content holds attention, and it will supply more of whatever works.
sentences.zh: 一个以最大化观看时长为训练目标的系统会学到：熟悉且情绪强烈的内容更能留住注意力，于是它会更多地提供任何有效的东西。

sentences.en: Over months a feed can drift towards the narrow and the loud, and from the inside the drift is almost invisible.
sentences.zh: 几个月下来，信息流可能逐渐偏向狭窄和喧闹的一端，而从内部看，这种偏移几乎不可见。

sentences.en: Yet the picture of a helpless audience is too simple.
sentences.zh: 然而，把受众描绘成无助的样子，未免过于简单。

sentences.en: Every recommendation is also a test: the system offers, the viewer responds, and the response becomes data for the next offer.
sentences.zh: 每一次推荐同时也是一次测试：系统提供内容，观看者作出反应，而这一反应又成为下一次提供内容的数据。

sentences.en: The system proposes, but every proposal is judged by a thumb that keeps scrolling or stops.
sentences.zh: 系统提出建议，但每个建议都由那根继续滑动或停下的拇指来评判。

sentences.en: A user who skips, searches and follows deliberately is, in effect, teaching the system what to value.
sentences.zh: 一个有意跳过、搜索和关注内容的用户，实际上是在教这个系统该看重什么。

sentences.en: Studies of online news find that the strongest predictor of what people read is still what they already believe, not what the platform pushes.
sentences.zh: 对网络新闻的研究发现，预测人们读什么最强的因素仍然是他们原本相信什么，而不是平台推送了什么。

sentences.en: The reasonable conclusion is that influence runs in both directions, and that responsibility is therefore shared.
sentences.zh: 合理的结论是：影响是双向的，因此责任也是共担的。

sentences.en: That is a less satisfying answer than blaming the machine, and a more accurate one.
sentences.zh: 这个答案不像把责任推给机器那样令人痛快，却更准确。

sentences.en: Regulation can demand transparency about how a feed is assembled; users can cultivate the small habit of asking why a particular clip appeared.
sentences.zh: 监管可以要求平台公开信息流是如何组装的；用户也可以养成一个小习惯，追问某个视频为什么会出现在眼前。

sentences.en: Neither will rescue anyone on its own, but together they turn a hidden process into a visible one, and visibility is where choice begins.
sentences.zh: 两者单独都无法拯救任何人，但合在一起，它们能把一个隐藏的过程变得可见，而可见正是选择的起点。

keyVocab.note: 语气较重，指在不被察觉的情况下影响他人判断
此处特指内容推荐的分发规则
强调缓慢、无意识的变化，而非突然转向
the strongest predictor of ... 表示“对……最有预测力的因素”
不可数名词，常与 demand、require 搭配

grammar.en: When you open a short-video app, the first clip has already been chosen for you, by a system that has watched your behaviour more closely than any friend has.
grammar.main: the first clip has already been chosen
grammar.subject: the first clip
grammar.modifiers: When 引导时间状语从句；by a system 引出施动者；that has watched your behaviour 是定语从句修饰 system；more closely than any friend has 是比较状语，has 后省略 watched your behaviour
grammar.logic: 时间从句先设场景，被动语态把焦点从“谁操作”移到“你已被安排”，比较结构强化系统对你的了解程度
grammar.zh: 当你打开短视频应用时，第一个视频已经替你选好了，选它的是一个比任何朋友都更密切关注你行为的系统。

grammar.en: A system trained to maximise watch time learns that familiar and emotionally charged content holds attention, and it will supply more of whatever works.
grammar.main: A system learns that ..., and it will supply more
grammar.subject: A system / it
grammar.object: that 引导的宾语从句 / more of whatever works
grammar.modifiers: trained to maximise watch time 是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 system；whatever works 是宾语从句作介词 of 的宾语

grammar.en: Regulation can demand transparency about how a feed is assembled; users can cultivate the small habit of asking why a particular clip appeared.
grammar.main: Regulation can demand transparency; users can cultivate the habit
grammar.subject: Regulation / users
grammar.modifiers: about how a feed is assembled 修饰 transparency；of asking why a particular clip appeared 修饰 habit，其中 why 从句作 asking 的宾语
grammar.logic: 分号并列两条对策，一条针对平台、一条针对用户，直接呼应上一句“责任共担”
grammar.zh: 监管可以要求公开信息流是如何组装的；用户也可以养成追问某个视频为何出现的习惯。

title: What a Grade Cannot Measure

sentences.en: A single number at the end of a term carries remarkable weight in a student's life, deciding scholarships, internships and sometimes self-respect.
sentences.zh: 学期末的一个数字在学生的生活中分量惊人，它决定着奖学金、实习机会，有时还决定着自尊。

sentences.en: Grades are not worthless; they are simply narrow.
sentences.zh: 分数并非毫无价值，它只是狭窄。

sentences.en: The trouble begins when a narrow instrument is asked to answer a broad question.
sentences.zh: 当一件狭窄的工具被要求回答一个宽泛的问题时，麻烦就开始了。

sentences.en: Parents, teachers and employers all read the same figure and draw very different conclusions from it.
sentences.zh: 家长、教师和雇主读到的是同一个数字，却从中得出很不相同的结论。

sentences.en: A grade records performance on a particular set of tasks, on a particular day, marked against a particular standard.
sentences.zh: 分数记录的是某一天、在某一套特定任务上的表现，并且是按照某一特定标准评定的。

sentences.en: What it rewards most reliably is the ability to produce the expected answer within the time allowed.
sentences.zh: 它最稳定地奖励的，是在规定时间内给出预期答案的能力。

sentences.en: It rewards the answer, not the question that produced it.
sentences.zh: 它奖励的是答案，而不是产生这个答案的那个问题。

sentences.en: It says something about preparation and something about speed, and it says almost nothing about curiosity, persistence, or the willingness to rewrite a first draft.
sentences.zh: 它能说明一些关于准备程度的事，也能说明一些关于速度的事，却几乎说不出好奇心、坚持，或愿意重写初稿的任何东西。

sentences.en: Two students with the same mark may have arrived by very different routes: one by steady work, the other by talent and a lucky set of questions.
sentences.zh: 两个拿到同样分数的学生，可能是沿着完全不同的路径走到这里的：一个靠稳定的努力，另一个靠天赋和一套运气不错的题目。

sentences.en: Defenders of grading answer, reasonably, that the alternative is worse.
sentences.zh: 为评分辩护的人会给出一个合理的回答：替代方案更糟。

sentences.en: Judgement without evidence slides easily into favouritism, and a system that cannot be explained to a parent or an employer soon loses its legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 没有证据支撑的判断很容易滑向偏袒，而一个无法向家长或雇主解释的制度很快就会失去正当性。

sentences.en: The problem, then, is not the existence of grades but the assumption that they exhaust what there is to know.
sentences.zh: 那么问题不在于分数本身的存在，而在于一种假定：分数已经穷尽了所有值得了解的东西。

sentences.en: Schools that take this seriously keep the number and add to it.
sentences.zh: 认真对待这一点的学校会保留这个数字，并在它之外增加别的东西。

sentences.en: The number becomes a beginning rather than a summary.
sentences.zh: 这个数字于是成为起点，而不是总结。

sentences.en: A short written comment, a portfolio of revised work, a record of a project that failed and was rebuilt, none of these replaces the exam, but each restores a dimension the exam cannot see.
sentences.zh: 一段简短的书面评语、一份经过修改的作品集、一份记录某个项目如何失败又被重建的档案，这些都不能取代考试，但每一样都补回了考试看不见的一个维度。

sentences.en: Measurement is a tool for looking, not a verdict on a person, and that distinction is worth teaching early.
sentences.zh: 测量是用于观察的工具，而不是对人的判决，而这个区别值得早早教给学生。

keyVocab.note: 此处把分数比作一件测量工具，强调其适用范围有限
指制度被接受、被认可的基础
此处不是“使疲惫”，而是“把……全部涵盖”
教育语境中指学生一段时间内作品的汇编
原为法庭用语，此处强调“对人的最终判定”

grammar.en: It says something about preparation and something about speed, and it says almost nothing about curiosity, persistence, or the willingness to rewrite a first draft.
grammar.main: It says something ... and it says almost nothing about ...
grammar.subject: It / it
grammar.modifiers: about preparation、about speed、about curiosity... 是并列介词短语，说明“说了什么”；to rewrite a first draft 是不定式作定语修饰 willingness
grammar.logic: and 连接正反两面，almost nothing 与 something 形成对照，用对照凸显分数的局限
grammar.zh: 它能说明准备情况，也能说明速度，却几乎说不出好奇心、坚持或愿意重写初稿。

grammar.en: Judgement without evidence slides easily into favouritism, and a system that cannot be explained to a parent or an employer soon loses its legitimacy.
grammar.main: Judgement slides into favouritism, and a system loses its legitimacy
grammar.subject: Judgement / a system
grammar.modifiers: without evidence 是介词短语作后置定语修饰 Judgement；that cannot be explained to a parent or an employer 是定语从句修饰 system
grammar.logic: 两个并列分句分别说明“无证据的判断”与“不可解释的制度”的后果，构成递进式论证，支撑上一句“替代方案更糟”
grammar.zh: 没有证据的判断容易滑向偏袒，而无法向家长或雇主解释的制度很快会失去正当性。

grammar.en: A short written comment, a portfolio of revised work, a record of a project that failed and was rebuilt, none of these replaces the exam, but each restores a dimension the exam cannot see.
grammar.main: none of these replaces the exam, but each restores a dimension
grammar.subject: none of these / each
grammar.modifiers: 句首三个名词短语是外位成分，由 none of these 复指；that failed and was rebuilt 是定语从句修饰 project；the exam cannot see 是省略关系词的定语从句修饰 dimension
grammar.logic: 先并列列举，再用 none ... but ... 构成让步转折：先否认替代，再肯定补充作用
grammar.zh: 一段简短评语、一份修改后的作品集、一份记录项目失败与重建的档案，这些都不能取代考试，但每一样都补回了考试看不见的维度。

whyWrong: exhaust 在此是“穷尽”，不是“使疲惫”。

options: Performance on particular tasks on a particular day
A student's curiosity and persistence

quiz.evidence: A grade records performance on a particular set of tasks, on a particular day, marked against a particular standard.
quiz.explain: 原文用三个 particular 强调分数只反映特定任务、特定日期、特定标准下的表现。
whyWrong: 文中明确说分数几乎反映不出好奇心和坚持。
修改后的作品属于作者建议补充的材料。
文中未提及家庭背景。

quiz.question: How does the author regard the defenders of grading?
options: Their concern is reasonable, but their conclusion is too narrow
They are dishonest about their motives
They are right that grades measure everything
They have no valid argument at all
quiz.evidence: Defenders of grading answer, reasonably, that the alternative is worse.
quiz.explain: 作者用 reasonably 承认其理由成立，随后指出真正的问题在于“分数已穷尽一切”的假定，即结论过窄。
whyWrong: 作者称其回答合理，并未质疑动机。
作者认为分数狭窄，不同意它能衡量一切。
作者承认其理由成立，只是结论不足。

quiz.question: Why does the author mention two students with the same mark?
options: To show that a mark hides very different paths to it
To argue that talent matters more than effort
To prove that exams are marked unfairly
To suggest that students should compare their marks
quiz.evidence: Two students with the same mark may have arrived by very different routes: one by steady work, the other by talent and a lucky set of questions.
quiz.explain: 作者并列努力与天赋运气两条路径，正是为了说明同一个分数背后可能完全不同，从而证明分数信息量有限。
whyWrong: 文中并列天赋与努力，没有排出高低。
文中未说评分不公。

title: Cheap Is Not the Same as Economical

sentences.en: A pair of shoes priced at a fifth of another pair looks like a bargain, and for a few months it is.
sentences.zh: 一双价格只有另一双五分之一的鞋看起来是笔划算的买卖，而且在最初几个月里确实是。

sentences.en: Then the sole separates, the money saved is spent a second time, and the bargain turns out to have been a loan.
sentences.zh: 然后鞋底开胶，省下的钱又被花了一次，那笔划算的买卖原来是一笔贷款。

sentences.en: The arithmetic of cost per use is simple, yet it is almost never the arithmetic we perform in the shop.
sentences.zh: 按使用次数计算成本的算术很简单，却几乎从不是我们在店里做的那道算术。

sentences.en: Economists describe this as a problem of information.
sentences.zh: 经济学家把这描述为一个信息问题。

sentences.en: A buyer cannot easily see how long a product will last, and a seller has little reason to advertise durability when a cheaper rival is on the next shelf.
sentences.zh: 买家很难看出一个产品能用多久，而当隔壁货架上就摆着更便宜的同类商品时，卖家也没有多少理由去宣传耐用性。

sentences.en: Where a cheaper substitute exists, the market tends to reward the price that is visible over the quality that is not.
sentences.zh: 只要存在更便宜的替代品，市场往往就会奖励看得见的价格，而不是看不见的质量。

sentences.en: Manufacturers learn the same lesson from the other side: a shorter life can be profitable, provided the failure arrives after the warranty has expired.
sentences.zh: 制造商从另一面学到同样的道理：只要故障出现在保修期结束之后，更短的使用寿命也可以是有利可图的。

sentences.en: The result is a market that quietly punishes the careful buyer.
sentences.zh: 结果就是一个悄悄惩罚谨慎买家的市场。

sentences.en: This is not an argument that expensive goods are always better.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说贵的东西总是更好。

sentences.en: Price is a noisy signal, reflecting brand, marketing and scarcity as much as material, and plenty of costly products fail early.
sentences.zh: 价格是一个嘈杂的信号，它既反映材料，也同样反映品牌、营销和稀缺程度，而且许多昂贵的产品很早就坏了。

sentences.en: Nor can every household afford the durable version today; for a family short of cash, the cheap pair is not foolish but necessary.
sentences.zh: 也不是每个家庭今天都买得起耐用的那一款；对一个现金紧张的家庭来说，买便宜的那双不是愚蠢，而是必需。

sentences.en: The useful conclusion is narrower than the advice to buy well.
sentences.zh: 有用的结论比“买好的”这句建议要窄。

sentences.en: Where a purchase will be used often and for years, it pays to calculate the cost per use rather than the cost at the till.
sentences.zh: 如果一件东西会被频繁使用很多年，那么计算每次使用的成本就比计算收银台前的价格更划算。

sentences.en: Where it will not, the cheap option is often the rational one.
sentences.zh: 如果不是这样，便宜的选择往往是理性的。

sentences.en: Frugality, properly understood, is not a habit of spending little; it is a habit of counting what a thing will cost over its whole life.
sentences.zh: 恰当地理解，节俭并不是少花钱的习惯，而是把一件东西一生的花费都算清楚的习惯。

keyVocab.note: 不可数名词，与 advertise、quality 等词常同现
a cheaper substitute 指价格更低的替代商品
经济学基本概念，指供给有限
作者重新定义：不是少花钱，而是算总账
the rational one 指“合乎理性的选择”

grammar.main: A buyer cannot see ..., and a seller has little reason
grammar.subject: A buyer / a seller
grammar.object: how long 引导的宾语从句 / little reason
grammar.modifiers: how long a product will last 是宾语从句；to advertise durability 是不定式作后置定语修饰 reason；when 引导时间状语从句
grammar.logic: and 并列买卖双方的处境，说明信息不对称不是某一方的问题，而是结构性结果

grammar.object: to calculate the cost per use（真正主语）
grammar.modifiers: Where 引导条件状语从句，限定适用范围；rather than 连接两个被比较的宾语
grammar.logic: 条件从句先划定边界，rather than 明确比较对象，使建议带有前提而非口号式断言
grammar.zh: 如果一件东西会被长期频繁使用，那么算每次使用的成本，比算收银台前的价格更值。

glossary.rival: n. 竞争对手；同类商品

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why low prices can cost more in the long run, and when they do not
How to bargain with shop assistants
Why manufacturers should extend warranties
How brands create a sense of luxury
quiz.evidence: The arithmetic of cost per use is simple, yet it is almost never the arithmetic we perform in the shop.
quiz.explain: 全文以“每次使用成本”为主线，说明便宜货长期可能更贵，同时承认现金紧张时买便宜货是理性的，故主旨包含条件。
whyWrong: 文章不涉及讨价还价。
保修期只是解释短寿命如何获利的一个细节。
品牌只是价格信号的一部分。

quiz.question: What does the author mean by saying the bargain 'turns out to have been a loan'?
options: The money saved has to be paid again when the product fails
The buyer must repay the shop in monthly instalments
The product was borrowed rather than bought
The shop lent the shoes to the buyer before payment
quiz.evidence: Then the sole separates, the money saved is spent a second time, and the bargain turns out to have been a loan.
quiz.explain: 前一分句说“省下的钱又被花了一次”，因此 loan 是比喻：省下的钱并非真正省下，只是延后支付。
whyWrong: 文中没有分期付款的情节。
商品是买下的，比喻的是后续支出。
并非先借后买的交易方式。

quiz.question: Why might manufacturers benefit from a shorter product life?
options: Because failure after the warranty period costs them nothing
Because short-lived products are cheaper to design
Because customers prefer to replace things often
Because longer life requires rarer materials
quiz.evidence: Manufacturers learn the same lesson from the other side: a shorter life can be profitable, provided the failure arrives after the warranty has expired.
quiz.explain: provided 从句给出关键条件：只要故障发生在保修期之后，厂商就不必承担维修成本，短寿命因而有利可图。
whyWrong: 文中说的是故障时点，不是设计成本。
文中未说消费者喜欢频繁更换。
稀有材料不是文中给出的原因。

quiz.question: What is the author's attitude towards expensive products?
options: Cautious: price is an unreliable sign of quality
Confident that higher prices always mean better quality
Dismissive: expensive goods are simply a waste of money
Indifferent: price has no relation to durability at all
quiz.evidence: Price is a noisy signal, reflecting brand, marketing and scarcity as much as material, and plenty of costly products fail early.
quiz.explain: noisy signal 与 plenty of costly products fail early 表明作者认为高价不能可靠地代表高质量，态度审慎。
whyWrong: 作者明确否认价格总能代表质量。
作者也承认耐用品在长期更划算。
作者认为价格与耐用性有关，只是信号嘈杂。

quiz.question: Why does the author say the cheap pair may be necessary for some families?
options: Because they cannot afford the durable version at present
Because cheap shoes are more comfortable to wear
Because durable goods are usually badly made
Because they replace their shoes very rarely
quiz.evidence: Nor can every household afford the durable version today; for a family short of cash, the cheap pair is not foolish but necessary.
quiz.explain: 原文用 short of cash 与 afford 说明限制在于当下的支付能力，因此便宜的选择是现实约束下的必需。
whyWrong: 文中未讨论舒适度。
作者认为耐用品可能更划算，未说做工差。
文中说的是现金紧张，不是更换频率低。

title: The River That Came Back

sentences.en: For most of the last century, the river running through the industrial quarter was treated as a drain.
sentences.zh: 在上个世纪的大部分时间里，流经工业区的那条河被当作一条排水沟。

sentences.en: Concrete banks were built to move water away as quickly as possible, and the water arrived downstream carrying whatever the factories had finished with.
sentences.zh: 人们修筑混凝土河岸，让水尽快排走，而水流到下游时，带着工厂用剩的一切。

sentences.en: Fish disappeared, and the children who played beside it were told to stay away.
sentences.zh: 鱼消失了，在河边玩耍的孩子也被叮嘱要离远一些。

sentences.en: When the city voted to reverse this in the 1990s, many treated the decision as sentimental.
sentences.zh: 当这座城市在二十世纪九十年代决定扭转这一做法时，许多人认为这个决定是感情用事。

sentences.en: The engineers who argued for restoration made a practical case rather than a romantic one.
sentences.zh: 主张修复的工程师提出的是务实的理由，而非浪漫的理由。

sentences.en: A river with a wetland edge absorbs floodwater that a concrete channel can only hurry along.
sentences.zh: 带有湿地边缘的河流能吸收洪水，而混凝土渠道只会让洪水更快地流走。

sentences.en: Shade from replanted banks lowers the water temperature, which allows fish to return; the returning fish, in turn, feed the birds that had left.
sentences.zh: 重新栽种的河岸投下的阴凉降低了水温，使鱼类得以回归；而回归的鱼又反过来喂养了那些曾经离开的鸟。

sentences.en: Within a decade the measured cost of flood damage along the lower reach had fallen, and the argument stopped being about beauty.
sentences.zh: 十年之内，下游河段洪水损失的可测算成本下降了，争论也不再围绕美观展开。

sentences.en: Restoration is not free, and it is not always right.
sentences.zh: 修复并非免费，也并非总是正确。

sentences.en: Land beside a river is expensive, and in a dense city the space given to a wetland is space taken from housing.
sentences.zh: 河边的土地很贵，在人口密集的城市里，给湿地的空间就是从住房那里拿走的空间。

sentences.en: Where a channel protects thousands of homes from a real and frequent threat, the honest answer may be to keep the concrete and improve it.
sentences.zh: 当一条渠道保护着成千上万的住宅免受真实而频繁的威胁时，诚实的答案也许是保留混凝土并加以改进。

sentences.en: The choice depends on what the river is being asked to do.
sentences.zh: 如何选择，取决于人们要这条河承担什么。

sentences.en: The lesson of the river is therefore about how environmental arguments are won.
sentences.zh: 因此，这条河带来的启示在于环境方面的论证是如何获胜的。

sentences.en: Appeals to beauty persuade those who are already convinced; appeals to cost, risk and function persuade everyone else.
sentences.zh: 对美的诉求只能说服那些已经被说服的人；而对成本、风险和功能的诉求才能说服其他人。

sentences.en: Nature, presented as a service rather than a sentiment, turns out to be a far more effective negotiator.
sentences.zh: 当自然被呈现为一种服务而非一种情感时，它原来是远为有效的谈判者。

sentences.en: That is a lesson with uses far beyond one river in one city, and it is not a comfortable one.
sentences.zh: 这个启示的用处远远超出某座城市的某条河，而它并不让人舒服。

keyVocab.note: 生态语境中指让河流恢复自然状态
能蓄洪、净水的自然系统
absorb floodwater 指吸纳洪水、减缓流速
常含贬义，指凭情感而非理性作判断
此处把自然拟人化，指其在政策博弈中的说服力

grammar.en: Concrete banks were built to move water away as quickly as possible, and the water arrived downstream carrying whatever the factories had finished with.
grammar.main: Concrete banks were built ..., and the water arrived downstream
grammar.subject: Concrete banks / the water
grammar.object: 无（第一分句为被动，第二分句无宾语）
grammar.modifiers: to move water away 是目的状语；as quickly as possible 是程度状语；carrying ... 是现在分词短语作伴随状语；whatever the factories had finished with 是 carrying 的宾语从句
grammar.logic: and 并列工程措施与其后果，分词状语补充说明后果的具体形态，暗示设计目标与实际问题之间的落差
grammar.zh: 人们修建混凝土河岸以尽快排走河水，而水到达下游时，带走了工厂用剩的一切。

grammar.en: Shade from replanted banks lowers the water temperature, which allows fish to return; the returning fish, in turn, feed the birds that had left.
grammar.main: Shade lowers the water temperature; the fish feed the birds
grammar.subject: Shade / the fish
grammar.modifiers: from replanted banks 是介词短语修饰 Shade；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整件事；that had left 是定语从句修饰 birds
grammar.logic: 分号连接生态链条的相邻两环，in turn 标示因果继续传递，which 从句把单一变化扩展为连锁效应
grammar.zh: 重新栽种的河岸带来的阴凉降低了水温，这使鱼得以回归；而回归的鱼又反过来喂养了曾经离开的鸟。

grammar.en: Land beside a river is expensive, and in a dense city the space given to a wetland is space taken from housing.
grammar.main: Land is expensive, and the space is space
grammar.subject: Land / the space
grammar.modifiers: beside a river 修饰 Land；given to a wetland 与 taken from housing 都是过去分词短语作后置定语，形成对称
grammar.logic: and 并列两重代价，第二个分句用对称结构把生态空间与住房供给直接对立，强化“零和”意味
grammar.zh: 河边的土地很贵，而在密集的城市里，给湿地的空间就是从住房中拿走的。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How a river was restored, and why practical arguments won the case
Why concrete channels are always the best form of flood defence
How to design a city park that attracts tourists
Why factories should be moved out of cities
quiz.evidence: The lesson of the river is therefore about how environmental arguments are won.
quiz.explain: 文章讲述河流从被当作排水沟到被修复的过程，并指出获胜的关键是把自然论证为一项服务，故主旨是过程加论证方式。
whyWrong: 作者承认渠道在特定情形下应保留，但未说它总是最好。
公园设计不是主题。
工厂搬迁未被讨论。

quiz.question: What does the author mean by presenting nature as 'a service'?
options: Nature understood through the benefits it provides to people
Nature managed by private companies for profit
Nature protected only for its beauty
Nature treated as a public utility owned by the city
quiz.evidence: Nature, presented as a service rather than a sentiment, turns out to be a far more effective negotiator.
quiz.explain: service 与 sentiment 对举，指把自然表述为蓄洪、降温等实际功能，而非仅供观赏的情感对象。
whyWrong: 文中谈的是论证方式，不是商业化经营。
作者恰恰说单靠美观说服力有限。
文中未涉及产权归属。

quiz.question: What effect does shade from replanted banks have?
options: It lowers water temperature and allows fish to return
It reduces the amount of floodwater reaching the city
It prevents factories from dumping waste into the river
It makes the river cheaper to maintain
quiz.evidence: Shade from replanted banks lowers the water temperature, which allows fish to return; the returning fish, in turn, feed the birds that had left.
quiz.explain: 原文明确：阴凉降低水温，进而使鱼回归，并继续带来鸟类回归的连锁效应。
whyWrong: 吸收洪水是湿地边缘的作用。
文中未说植树能阻止排污。
文中未讨论维护费用下降。

quiz.question: What does the author think of keeping concrete channels in some places?
options: It may be the honest choice where the flood threat is real and frequent
It is never acceptable under any circumstances
It is always better than restoring a wetland
It is a decision that should not be debated publicly
quiz.evidence: Where a channel protects thousands of homes from a real and frequent threat, the honest answer may be to keep the concrete and improve it.
quiz.explain: 作者用 the honest answer may be 表明在真实且频繁的洪水威胁下，保留并改进渠道是务实的选择。
whyWrong: 作者承认这种情形，因此不是绝不可接受。
作者同时认为下游损失成本下降，说明并非处处渠道更好。
全文正是在公开讨论这一选择。

quiz.question: Why did the argument stop being about beauty?
options: Because measurable costs fell, giving a practical reason to continue
Because residents no longer cared about the view
Because the wetland was hidden from public view
Because engineers disliked discussing aesthetics
quiz.evidence: Within a decade the measured cost of flood damage along the lower reach had fallen, and the argument stopped being about beauty.
quiz.explain: 前半句给出可测算的成本下降，说明争论的支点从审美转向了实效，这正是后半句的原因。
whyWrong: 文中未说居民不再在意景观。
湿地并未被隐藏。
工程师只是选择了更有效的论据。

title: The Map That Ended a Theory

sentences.en: In the summer of 1854, a disease swept through a crowded district of London, killing hundreds of people in a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 1854年夏天，一种疾病席卷了伦敦一个拥挤的街区，几周内夺去数百人的生命。

sentences.en: The accepted explanation was that the illness travelled through the air, carried by the smell of decay.
sentences.zh: 当时公认的解释是，这种病通过空气传播，由腐烂的气味携带。

sentences.en: A physician who had been studying the outbreak doubted this, and he did something unusual: he drew a map.
sentences.zh: 一位一直在研究这次疫情的医生对此表示怀疑，而他做了一件不寻常的事：他画了一张地图。

sentences.en: The map marked every death with a small dash and every public water pump with a circle.
sentences.zh: 地图上用一个小短横标记每一例死亡，用一个圆圈标记每一个公共水泵。

sentences.en: The dashes clustered around one pump in Broad Street, and the clustering was far too tight to be an accident.
sentences.zh: 这些短横聚集在宽街的一台水泵周围，聚集得如此紧密，绝不可能是巧合。

sentences.en: Deaths were concentrated among those who drew water there, and the pattern held even where the smell was worst elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 死亡集中在那些在那里取水的人当中，即使在其他地方气味最难闻的区域，这一模式依然成立。

sentences.en: One brewery nearby, whose workers drank beer instead of water, was almost untouched, a detail that a theory of bad air could not explain.
sentences.zh: 附近的一家啤酒厂几乎未受影响，因为那里的工人喝啤酒而不喝水——这个细节是“污浊空气”致病说无法解释的。

sentences.en: The map did not convince everyone at once, and it did not settle the question by itself.
sentences.zh: 这张地图并没有立刻说服所有人，也没有单独解决这个问题。

sentences.en: The physician had no instrument capable of showing the organism, so his argument rested on pattern rather than mechanism.
sentences.zh: 这位医生没有能显示病原体的仪器，因此他的论证依靠的是模式，而不是机理。

sentences.en: Officials removed the handle from the pump, the outbreak faded, and the fading was read as proof by some and as coincidence by others.
sentences.zh: 官员拆掉了水泵的把手，疫情逐渐消退，而这种消退被一些人视为证据，被另一些人视为巧合。

sentences.en: Acceptance came only when the waterborne theory was supported by work that could identify the cause directly.
sentences.zh: 直到“水源传播”说得到能够直接识别病因的研究支持，这一理论才被接受。

sentences.en: The episode is often told as a story about a hero and a discovery, which flatters both the hero and the discovery.
sentences.zh: 这件事常被讲成一个关于英雄与发现的故事，而这种讲法既美化了英雄，也美化了发现。

sentences.en: It is more useful as a story about method: a theory that explained everything explained nothing in particular, and a simple map made a specific claim that could be checked.
sentences.zh: 把它当作一个关于方法的故事更有用：一个能解释一切的理论其实什么也没具体解释，而一张简单的地图提出了一个可以被检验的具体主张。

sentences.en: Evidence rarely kills an idea with a single blow; it makes the idea expensive to keep.
sentences.zh: 证据很少能一击杀死一个观念；它只是让坚持这个观念变得代价高昂。

keyVocab.note: 常与 disease 等词搭配，指疾病的突然扩散
比 doctor 正式，常见于历史与医学文本
描述数据或病例在空间上密集出现
此处指疾病传播的具体作用方式
把结果解释为偶然，是拒绝接受因果论证的常见方式
此处不是“奉承某人”，而是“使叙述显得更好看”

grammar.en: A physician who had been studying the outbreak doubted this, and he did something unusual: he drew a map.
grammar.main: A physician doubted this, and he did something unusual
grammar.subject: A physician / he
grammar.modifiers: who had been studying the outbreak 是定语从句修饰 physician，用过去完成进行时表示“在此之前一直持续”的动作；冒号后的分句解释 something unusual 的具体内容
grammar.logic: and 推进叙事，冒号把抽象说法落实为具体行动，形成“怀疑—行动”的紧凑节奏
grammar.zh: 一位一直在研究这次疫情的医生对此表示怀疑，而他做了一件不寻常的事：他画了一张地图。

grammar.en: One brewery nearby, whose workers drank beer instead of water, was almost untouched, a detail that a theory of bad air could not explain.
grammar.main: One brewery was almost untouched
grammar.subject: One brewery
grammar.modifiers: whose workers drank beer instead of water 是非限制性定语从句，补充说明该厂未受影响的原因；a detail that ... 是同位语，其中 that 从句修饰 detail
grammar.logic: 主句陈述事实，同位语随即评价该事实的证据价值，构成“事实—意义”的两步推进
grammar.zh: 附近一家啤酒厂的工人喝啤酒而不喝水，因此几乎未受影响，而这个细节是污浊空气说无法解释的。

grammar.en: It is more useful as a story about method: a theory that explained everything explained nothing in particular, and a simple map made a specific claim that could be checked.
grammar.main: It is more useful as a story about method
grammar.subject: It
grammar.modifiers: 冒号后两个并列分句解释 method 的内涵；that explained everything 修饰 theory；that could be checked 修饰 claim
grammar.logic: 冒号引出解释，两个分句用 explained everything 与 nothing in particular 的反差支撑“方法比英雄更重要”的判断
grammar.zh: 把它当作关于方法的故事更有用：一个能解释一切的理论其实什么也没具体解释，而一张简单的地图提出了可被检验的具体主张。

quiz.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How a map challenged an accepted explanation, and what that shows about evidence
How London rebuilt its water supply in the nineteenth century
Why beer was safer than water in the nineteenth century
How a physician became famous almost by accident
quiz.evidence: It is more useful as a story about method: a theory that explained everything explained nothing in particular, and a simple map made a specific claim that could be checked.
quiz.explain: 文章叙述地图如何反驳空气传播说，并在结尾把这件事提升为关于方法的讨论，故主旨包含史实与启示两层。
whyWrong: 供水系统改造不是主题。
啤酒厂只是作为反例细节出现。
作者恰恰反对把此事讲成英雄故事。

quiz.question: What does the author mean by saying evidence 'makes the idea expensive to keep'?
options: It raises the cost of continuing to believe something
It forces researchers to spend more money on instruments
It makes a theory costly to publish in journals
It turns a belief into a financial burden for the city
quiz.evidence: Evidence rarely kills an idea with a single blow; it makes the idea expensive to keep.
quiz.explain: 与前半句“很少一击致命”呼应，expensive 是比喻：继续坚持该观念要付出越来越高的解释代价。
whyWrong: 文中说的是观念的成本，不是研究经费。
发表费用未被提及。
此处是比喻，不涉及实际财政负担。

quiz.question: Why was the brewery almost untouched?
options: Because its workers drank beer rather than water
Because it stood far away from Broad Street
Because its owner had closed it for the summer
Because all beer was boiled before it was sold
quiz.evidence: One brewery nearby, whose workers drank beer instead of water, was almost untouched, a detail that a theory of bad air could not explain.
quiz.explain: 定语从句直接给出原因：工人喝啤酒而不喝水，因此没有接触被污染的水源。
whyWrong: 原文用 nearby 说明距离很近。
未提及停产。
文中只说了工人喝啤酒，未提煮沸工序。

quiz.question: How does the author regard the familiar story of a hero and a discovery?
options: It is flattering but less instructive than a story about method
It is the most accurate account available
It is entirely false and should be forgotten
It is useful mainly for remembering dates
quiz.evidence: The episode is often told as a story about a hero and a discovery, which flatters both the hero and the discovery.
quiz.explain: flatters 含批评意味，随后作者提出“关于方法的故事更有用”，说明他认为英雄叙事不够有教益。
whyWrong: 作者说这种讲法美化了双方，并非最准确。
作者未说它完全虚假，只说不够有用。
文中未讨论年代记忆。

quiz.question: Why did some people treat the fading of the outbreak as coincidence?
options: Because the link between water and illness had not been shown directly
Because the pump handle was never actually removed
Because the outbreak had already ended before the map was drawn
Because the physician refused to publish his findings
quiz.evidence: Acceptance came only when the waterborne theory was supported by work that could identify the cause directly.
quiz.explain: 既然接受要等到能直接识别病因的研究出现，可见此前只有模式证据，反对者便可把消退解释为巧合。
whyWrong: 文中明确说把手被拆掉了。
文中未说疫情在画图前已自行结束。
文中未说医生拒绝公布发现。

title: The Words We Borrow

sentences.en: English contains an extraordinary number of words taken from other languages, and its speakers rarely notice.
sentences.zh: 英语中含有大量取自其他语言的词，而说英语的人很少注意到这一点。

sentences.en: Sugar, algebra, tea, piano and typhoon all arrived from elsewhere, and each arrived together with the thing it named.
sentences.zh: sugar、algebra、tea、piano 和 typhoon 都来自别处，而且每一个都是和它所命名的事物一起来的。

sentences.en: Borrowing is usually described as a sign of vitality, and it is also a reminder that the border between a language and its neighbours has always been porous.
sentences.zh: 借用通常被描述为活力的标志，它也提醒我们：一种语言与其邻近语言之间的边界从来都是可以渗透的。

sentences.en: Borrowing happens for practical reasons long before it happens for prestige.
sentences.zh: 借用的发生，出于实用原因远早于出于声望考虑。

sentences.en: A language that meets a new object, a new food or a new technique needs a name, and inventing one is harder than accepting the one that arrives with the object.
sentences.zh: 一种语言遇到新物品、新食物或新技术时需要一个名称，而发明一个名称比接受随物品一起来的那个名称要难。

sentences.en: The borrowed word carries a little of the journey with it, which is part of its appeal.
sentences.zh: 借来的词身上带着一点它的旅程，而这正是它吸引力的一部分。

sentences.en: When the borrowed word survives alongside a native one, the two usually drift apart: the borrowed term begins to sound technical or official, while the native word stays familiar.
sentences.zh: 当借词与本土词并存时，两者通常会分化：借来的词开始显得专业或正式，而本土词则保持亲切。

sentences.en: Concern about borrowing is not new, and it is not foolish.
sentences.zh: 对借用的担忧并不新鲜，也并不愚蠢。

sentences.en: If a language loses the words for its own institutions, something is lost with them, and that loss is hard to reverse.
sentences.zh: 如果一种语言失去了指称自身制度的词语，那么有些东西也随之失去，而这种失去很难逆转。

sentences.en: Yet the history of purist campaigns is largely a history of failure: languages that tried to seal their borders produced awkward replacements that nobody used, while the words they resisted settled in for good.
sentences.zh: 然而，纯粹主义运动的历史在很大程度上是一部失败史：试图封锁边界的语言造出了没人使用的生硬替代词，而它们所抵制的那些词却永久地留了下来。

sentences.en: What survives is not purity but proportion.
sentences.zh: 留存下来的不是纯粹，而是比例。

sentences.en: A healthy language borrows freely and still makes new words of its own; it takes what it needs and reshapes it until the shape fits.
sentences.zh: 健康的语言自由地借用，同时仍然自己造新词；它取用所需，并重塑它，直到形状合适。

sentences.en: A language that borrows nothing is usually a language that has stopped meeting anything new.
sentences.zh: 一种什么也不借的语言，通常是一种不再遇见任何新事物的语言。

sentences.en: English is not endangered by the words it has absorbed.
sentences.zh: 英语并没有因为吸收了这些词而受到威胁。

sentences.en: It is defined by them.
sentences.zh: 它恰恰是由这些词所定义的。

keyVocab.note: 不可数名词，a sign of vitality 表示活力的标志
此处为比喻，指语言边界容易被穿越
与 practical reasons 对照，指为显得体面而借用
purist campaigns 指主张清除外来词的运动
此处指借用与自造之间的恰当配比

They have successfully protected many languages

quiz.question: Why does the author mention sugar, algebra, tea, piano and typhoon?
options: To show that borrowed words arrived together with the things they named
To prove that English has more words than other languages
To list the words that learners find hardest
To argue that these words should be replaced
quiz.evidence: Sugar, algebra, tea, piano and typhoon all arrived from elsewhere, and each arrived together with the thing it named.
quiz.explain: 作者用这几个词证明“词随物来”，为下一段“借用出于实用需要”的论点提供例证。

title: The Repair Table

sentences.en: On the first Saturday of each month, a community centre places a long table near its entrance and invites residents to bring broken household objects.
sentences.zh: 每月第一个周六，一家社区中心会在入口附近摆一张长桌，邀请居民带来损坏的家居物品。

sentences.en: Volunteer repairers work beside the owners, explaining each step rather than taking the objects away and returning them without discussion.
sentences.zh: 志愿维修人员和物主一起动手，解释每个步骤，而非把东西拿走、不加说明地修好送回。

sentences.en: The aim is to share practical knowledge as well as extend the life of useful products.
sentences.zh: 目的既是延长实用物品的寿命，也是分享实用知识。

sentences.en: For many visitors, the surprising part is discovering how small the original problem was.
sentences.zh: 对许多来访者来说，令人意外的是发现最初的问题竟那么小。

sentences.en: A loose connection or a damaged switch may make an entire lamp appear useless, even though most of its parts still work.
sentences.zh: 连接松动或开关损坏，可能让整盏灯看起来毫无用处，即使大部分零件仍能工作。

sentences.en: Seeing the repair changes the owner's understanding of what has been thrown away and what might be saved next time.
sentences.zh: 目睹维修过程改变了物主对已丢弃物品以及下次可能保留物品的看法。

sentences.en: However, the volunteers do not promise to fix everything, and they leave dangerous electrical work to qualified professionals.
sentences.zh: 不过，志愿者并不承诺修好所有东西，危险的电气维修交由合格专业人士处理。

sentences.en: Some products are sealed so tightly that opening them would cause further damage, while replacement parts for others are difficult to obtain.
sentences.zh: 有些产品封得过于严密，打开便会造成更多损坏；另一些产品则难以获取替换零件。

sentences.en: These limits reveal that the ability to repair depends partly on decisions made long before a customer buys the product.
sentences.zh: 这些限制表明，可维修性部分取决于顾客购买产品很久以前就已作出的设计决策。

sentences.en: The repair table therefore raises a wider question about design, alongside its immediate benefits for individual households.
sentences.zh: 因此，维修桌除了直接帮助家庭，也提出了更广泛的设计问题。

sentences.en: If manufacturers provide clear instructions and affordable spare parts, keeping a product in use may become a realistic choice rather than a specialist hobby.
sentences.zh: 如果制造商提供清晰说明和价格合理的备件，继续使用产品就可能成为可行选择，而不只是专业爱好。

sentences.en: Visitors leave with different outcomes: some carry a working object, while others carry a better explanation of why their object cannot safely be repaired.
sentences.zh: 来访者的收获各不相同：有人带走恢复工作的物品，有人则更清楚地知道自己的物品为什么不能安全维修。

sentences.en: Both outcomes can support a more informed decision when another product eventually needs replacing.
sentences.zh: 当另一件产品最终需要更换时，两种收获都有助于作出更明智的决定。

grammar.en: Some products are sealed so tightly that opening them would cause further damage, while replacement parts for others are difficult to obtain.
grammar.zh: 有些产品封得过于严密，打开便会造成更多损坏；另一些产品则难以获取替换零件。
grammar.main: Some products are sealed so tightly
grammar.subject: Some products
grammar.modifiers: so…that… 引出结果；while 连接对比的情况。
grammar.logic: 一个句子并列说明无法维修的两类原因：难以打开和缺少备件。

grammar.en: If manufacturers provide clear instructions and affordable spare parts, keeping a product in use may become a realistic choice rather than a specialist hobby.
grammar.zh: 如果制造商提供清晰说明和价格合理的备件，继续使用产品就可能成为可行选择，而不只是专业爱好。
grammar.main: keeping a product in use may become a choice
grammar.subject: keeping a product in use
grammar.modifiers: If 引导条件状语从句；rather than 对比现实选择与专业爱好。
grammar.logic: 动名词短语作主语，说明制造商的支持会改变维修的可行性。

options: Every object can be repaired by volunteers

title: The Quiet Cost of Switching Tasks

sentences.en: At the end of a busy afternoon, Chen could name many things he had started, yet very few he had actually finished.
sentences.zh: 忙碌的一下午结束时，陈能列出许多已开始的事，却几乎说不出真正做完了什么。

sentences.en: He had switched repeatedly between an assignment, messages from classmates, a shopping page, and a video that promised advice on studying efficiently.
sentences.zh: 他不断在作业、同学消息、购物页面和一段号称教授高效学习方法的视频之间切换。

sentences.en: Each change seemed brief enough to ignore, but returning to the assignment meant finding his place and rebuilding the argument in his head.
sentences.zh: 每次切换似乎短得可以忽略，但回到作业时，他都得重新定位进度，在脑中重建论证。

sentences.en: Chen decided to try a modest experiment rather than blame himself for lacking determination.
sentences.zh: 陈决定做一个小实验，而不是责怪自己缺乏毅力。

sentences.en: For the next three afternoons, he left his phone in a drawer and worked on one clearly defined part of the assignment before taking a break.
sentences.zh: 接下来的三个下午，他把手机放进抽屉，先完成作业中一个明确划定的部分，再休息。

sentences.en: He kept a sheet of paper nearby to note unrelated ideas, so that remembering an errand would not require immediately opening another application.
sentences.zh: 他在旁边放了一张纸记录无关的想法，这样想起一件杂事时就不必立刻打开另一个应用。

sentences.en: The arrangement did not remove every distraction, and one afternoon a necessary call interrupted his work.
sentences.zh: 这种安排并未消除所有干扰，其中一个下午，一通必要的电话打断了他的工作。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, finishing a small section gave him a clearer sense of progress than spending the same time surrounded by several unfinished tasks.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，完成一小节，比用同样时间处理好几项未完任务更能让他感到进展。

sentences.en: He also found it easier to decide what to do next when the current step had a visible ending.
sentences.zh: 当眼下的步骤有明确终点时，他也更容易决定下一步做什么。

sentences.en: His experience does not establish a universal rule about concentration, but it points to a useful question for anyone who feels constantly busy.
sentences.zh: 他的经历不能确立一条普遍适用的专注规律，却为总觉得忙碌的人提供了一个有用问题。

sentences.en: Instead of asking only how long we worked, we might ask how often we had to start the same work again.
sentences.zh: 除了问自己工作了多久，我们还可以问，同一项工作究竟被迫重新开始了多少次。

sentences.en: That question can help us design a working environment in which returning to a task is less frequently necessary and progress is easier to recognise.
sentences.zh: 这个问题有助于设计一种工作环境，减少反复返回任务的必要，也让进展更容易辨认。

grammar.en: He kept a sheet of paper nearby to note unrelated ideas, so that remembering an errand would not require immediately opening another application.
grammar.zh: 他在旁边放了一张纸记录无关的想法，这样想起一件杂事时就不必立刻打开另一个应用。

title: A Bus That People Can Trust

sentences.en: When a town asks why residents prefer driving to taking the bus, the first answer is often that the journey takes too long.
sentences.zh: 当一个城镇询问居民为什么宁愿开车而不乘公交时，最常见的回答是行程太久。

sentences.en: Yet a closer conversation may reveal that the uncertain waiting time matters as much as the time spent moving.
sentences.zh: 但深入交谈可能发现，不确定的候车时间与行车时间同样重要。

sentences.en: A passenger who cannot predict whether a bus will arrive in two minutes or twenty must allow extra time for the entire trip.
sentences.zh: 如果乘客无法预测公交车会在两分钟还是二十分钟后到达，就必须为整段行程预留额外时间。

sentences.en: Consider two routes with the same average journey time but very different patterns of arrival.
sentences.zh: 设想两条平均行程时间相同、到站规律却截然不同的路线。

sentences.en: On one route, buses arrive at regular intervals; on the other, several may appear together after a long gap.
sentences.zh: 一条路线的公交车按固定间隔到达；另一条则可能久等之后几辆车一起来。

sentences.en: For someone travelling to an examination or collecting a child, the second pattern creates a risk that the average does not describe.
sentences.zh: 对赶考或接孩子的人来说，后一种模式带来的风险无法由平均数体现。

sentences.en: Improving the experience therefore involves more than adding a faster vehicle to an unreliable service.
sentences.zh: 因此，改善乘车体验不只是为不可靠的服务添上一辆速度更快的车。

sentences.en: Clear information about delays can help, but it cannot replace timetables that can usually be followed in ordinary traffic.
sentences.zh: 清晰的延误信息有所帮助，却不能替代在正常交通条件下通常能遵守的时刻表。

sentences.en: Planners may also need to examine junctions where buses repeatedly lose time and stops where boarding becomes unnecessarily slow.
sentences.zh: 规划者还可能需要研究公交车经常耽搁的路口，以及上车过程不必要地缓慢的站点。

sentences.en: No single change will make public transport suitable for every journey, especially in places where homes and workplaces are far apart.
sentences.zh: 没有哪项单一变化能让公共交通适合所有行程，尤其是在居住地与工作地相距甚远的地方。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, treating reliability as a central feature rather than a minor bonus gives planners a more accurate picture of what passengers need.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，把可靠性视为核心特征而非附加好处，能让规划者更准确地了解乘客需求。

sentences.en: Asking passengers how early they leave home for an important appointment may reveal a hidden part of the journey that a timetable alone would miss.
sentences.zh: 询问乘客为了重要约会会提前多久出门，可能揭示单靠时刻表无法看到的隐性出行时间。

sentences.en: Reducing that burden could make an ordinary bus trip feel considerably more manageable.
sentences.zh: 减轻这种负担，可能让普通公交行程更容易安排。

grammar.en: A passenger who cannot predict whether a bus will arrive in two minutes or twenty must allow extra time for the entire trip.
grammar.zh: 如果乘客无法预测公交车会在两分钟还是二十分钟后到达，就必须为整段行程预留额外时间。
grammar.main: A passenger must allow extra time
grammar.subject: A passenger
grammar.modifiers: who 引导定语从句；whether…or… 引出两个可能到站时间。
grammar.logic: 主干说明必须预留时间，定语从句交代乘客面临的不确定性。

grammar.en: Nevertheless, treating reliability as a central feature rather than a minor bonus gives planners a more accurate picture of what passengers need.
grammar.zh: 尽管如此，把可靠性视为核心特征而非附加好处，能让规划者更准确地了解乘客需求。
grammar.main: treating reliability as a central feature gives planners a picture
grammar.subject: treating reliability as a central feature rather than a minor bonus
grammar.modifiers: of what passengers need 补充 picture 的内容。
grammar.logic: 动名词短语作主语，give 后接间接宾语与直接宾语。

quiz.question: What feature of bus services does the writer emphasise?
options: The same route for every passenger
Predictable and reliable arrival
The colour of vehicles
The complete removal of bus stops
quiz.evidence: Nevertheless, treating reliability as a central feature rather than a minor bonus gives planners a more accurate picture of what passengers need.
quiz.explain: 文章重点是可靠性，末句明确将其定位为核心特征。
whyWrong: 作者承认不同出行有不同需要。
车辆颜色与文章论点无关。
作者建议研究站点效率，而非取消所有站点。

quiz.question: What can the average journey time fail to show?
options: The risk created by irregular arrivals
The exact colour of the bus
Whether a town has any schools
The total population of a country
quiz.evidence: For someone travelling to an examination or collecting a child, the second pattern creates a risk that the average does not describe.
quiz.explain: 平均耗时相同仍可能有规律与扎堆到达的差异，影响赶时间的人。
whyWrong: 文章并未讨论车身颜色。
学校存在与否不是均值的讨论对象。
全国人口并非本文指标。

quiz.question: What does the writer think about delay information?
options: It removes the need to improve service
It is useless in every situation
It makes all journeys equally suitable for buses
It helps but cannot replace a dependable timetable
quiz.evidence: Clear information about delays can help, but it cannot replace timetables that can usually be followed in ordinary traffic.
quiz.explain: can help 与 cannot replace 同时承认信息价值和其局限。
whyWrong: 信息不能取代实际服务可靠性。
作者明确说信息可以有所帮助。
最后一段否认单一措施适合所有行程。
